$schema: Hand-curated tag overrides for genuine exceptions the rules in scripts/tag_spells.py cannot fairly resolve. Key is "name|tradition" (lowercased). Each entry may set add[], remove[], and a note. Overrides are applied after the rules and always win. Keys starting with $ or _ are ignored.

minor demon|demonology.note: the 'heals 3d6' option heals a summoned demon, not an ally — not a healing tool

bestow mark of darkness|demonology.note: 'heal 3d6' targets a demon; spell is a Corruption/curse effect

conjure servant|conjuration.note: 'heal 1d6' repairs the conjured servant; this is a utility summon

conjure steeds|conjuration.note: 'become compelled by any creature that damages them' is a summon drawback, not the caster controlling a target

exorcism|exorcist.note: removes charmed/compelled/frightened from a target; phrased like a self-escape ('remove the affliction from it') so the rule misses it

purge the unclean|theurgy.note: dedicated cleanse — repeats a roll to remove afflictions; escape-style phrasing

introspective trance|soul.note: self heal + remove diseased/poisoned; escape-style phrasing

song of slumber|song.note: 'removes these afflictions' is the sleep it inflicted ending, not a cure
